name: l_shaped_plate_rectangular_cut
description: An L-shaped plate made from a polyline base with a rectangular through cut.
source_license: Project-authored example; not from an external dataset.
derived_by: Hand-authored from validated Prompt2ParametricCAD eval JSON.
construction_plan: Use a polyline base when the main outline is a straight-edged non-rectangle.
List the outer boundary points in order and do not repeat the first point.
Extrude the polyline to make the plate thickness.
Cut a rectangle on base.top inside the solid region.
notes: Use polyline for arbitrary straight-edged closed profiles.
Do not use a template name like bracket when the geometry can be represented directly as points.
